weaknesses: The abstract misrepresents the contributions by focusing on model arithmetic, which is not the main topic of the paper.
Claims regarding the novelty of the Incremental Randomized Smoothing (IRS) framework are overstated, as similar incremental approaches exist in the literature.
The empirical evaluation lacks a comparison with other incremental certification methods, limiting the context for claimed speedups.
strengths: The paper introduces a novel algorithm for incremental certification, which addresses a significant limitation in existing randomized smoothing techniques.
The evaluation demonstrates substantial speedups in certification, providing empirical support for the proposed method.
